tools.name: check_tool_change
tools.description: Find which saved jobs would break if a tool's declared contract changed.

tools.name: check_tool_fallback
tools.description: Rank supplied replacement tools for a saved job and check top-level field translations.

tools.name: check_tool_replies
tools.description: Compare recorded tool replies at the fields a saved job uses and find drift.

tools.name: verify_batch_handoff
tools.description: Find missing, changed, duplicate or unexpected records by ID and return the exact IDs to retry.

tools.name: check_batch_recovery
tools.description: After a partial batch write or timeout, use supplied destination evidence to choose skip, retry, or the exact read-only lookup for each unresolved operation.
